question: What is in the Group Reporting series?

scene.title: SAP Group Reporting: three parts

narration.text: The SAP Group Reporting series has three parts, about 44 minutes of reading in total.
Part 1, ten minutes, covers foundations and master data. It treats consolidation as a financial architecture decision.
Part 2, fifteen minutes, walks the period-end close step by step, from the Data Monitor through currency translation and intercompany elimination.
Part 3 is the longest at nineteen minutes. It covers investments, matrix consolidation and the reporting stack up to SAP Analytics Cloud.

items.title: Part 1: Foundations & Master Data
items.subtitle: Why consolidation is a financial architecture decision, plus the platform and master-data skeleton seen through a BDAT lens. 10 min

items.title: Part 2: The Period-End Close Cycle
items.subtitle: The close as a gated sequence: Data Monitor, currency translation, intercompany elimination, Consolidation Monitor. 15 min

items.title: Part 3: Investments, Matrix Consolidation & Reporting
items.subtitle: Consolidation of investments, matrix consolidation and the CDS-based reporting stack up to SAP Analytics Cloud. 19 min
